newsitem.title: CHINA: Beijing ethylene plant shut following blast.
newsitem.headline: Beijing ethylene plant shut following blast.

text.p: Ethylene production at a big petrochemical plant on the outskirts of Beijing will be halted for at least one year after a huge explosion last week, a plant official said on Wednesday.
"The plant has been sealed off," said an official of the Dongfang Chemical Factory. "We will be out of production for at least one year."
The plant was hit by an explosion and fire that killed at least three people and injured 64 on Friday.
The cause is still under investigation, the official said.
The plant, which produced 110,000 to 120,000 tonnes of ethylene last year, had used imported naphtha as well as naphtha from the big Daqing oilfield in northeastern China as feedstock.
